repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-local-storage
repository.purpose: Browser localStorage-backed bounded storage adapter for the Webex SDK webex-core storage layer.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Any change to src/index.js that alters observable behavior of bind, get, put, del, or clear.
task_playbooks.fallback: No automated test executes this module, so verify manually in a browser and state in the PR that no suite observed the change. If the behavior in question is clear() scope, the at-rest document layout, or the published constructor signature, stop and escalate to @webex/web-client before editing.

glossary.definition: The single localStorage key under which one adapter instance stores every namespace.
glossary.notes: Fixed at construction and captured in a closure, so it cannot be reassigned after bindings exist.

glossary.definition: The host's isolation unit within the stored document, one per webex plugin.
glossary.notes: Isolates get, put, and del. It does NOT isolate clear(), which removes the whole basekey entry.

glossary.definition: A namespace-scoped store returned by bind(), implemented by the inner Bound class.
glossary.notes: Holds no data; its namespace and logger live in module-level WeakMaps.

glossary.definition: The webex-core storage role this package fills: durable, size-limited storage selected via config.storage.boundedAdapter.
glossary.notes: Contrast with the unbounded adapter, which this package does not provide.

evidence_rules.requirement: Only cite a script that exists in package.json scripts. Do not cite test:integration or test:coverage; neither is defined in this package.
evidence_rules.notes: The aggregate test script is defined but broken: it chains the undefined test:integration and exits 1.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavior claim in src/index.js. Do not cite README.md as evidence; it is registered reference-only and contradicts the code on clear() scope.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not admissible rationale for this package; its manifest category is cat2-legacy.

evidence_rules.requirement: Do not claim a behavior is verified by tests. No automated test executes this module: the Node route skips all 21 cases and the browser route completes 0 tests while exiting 0.
evidence_rules.notes: Check the reported test count, never the exit code.

evidence_rules.requirement: Resolve imports against package.json dependencies. The only runtime import is NotFoundError from @webex/webex-core.
evidence_rules.notes: The browser localStorage global is used directly with no import and no feature detection.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not describe clear() as namespace-scoped.
negative_guidance.why: It removes the entire basekey entry and therefore every namespace. README.md states otherwise and is wrong.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat a passing test:unit or test:browser run as verification.
negative_guidance.why: Both exit 0 without executing anything, so they mask regressions rather than catching them.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not use truthiness to test whether a stored value exists.
negative_guidance.why: Only typeof value !== 'undefined' preserves legitimately stored 0, false, null, and empty string.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add a test:unit case that assumes localStorage.
negative_guidance.why: The shared jest config pins testEnvironment to node, which is why the existing suite is wrapped in skipInNode.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume this adapter is interchangeable with MemoryStoreAdapter.
negative_guidance.why: MemoryStoreAdapter scopes clear() to its own map; swapping adapters changes data-destruction behavior.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log stored values or widen what is persisted.
negative_guidance.why: In a browser bundle this adapter holds OAuth access and refresh tokens as plaintext JSON.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not run or cite the aggregate test script.
negative_guidance.why: It chains test:integration, which this package does not define, so it exits 1 before reaching the browser suite. It is recorded here only for manifest parity.

high.expectation: The claim is grounded in src/index.js or package.json and the affected consumers are named.

medium.expectation: Omit rationale that only commit history would supply; this package's category is cat2-legacy, so history is not admissible evidence.

low.expectation: Stop and report the gap. Mark it [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] rather than inferring intent, and route it to @webex/web-client.

rules: Orientation first: say what the folder owns before describing how to use it.

Update the Verification section of src/docs/README.md
Reassess whether the browser route can be repaired in @webex/storage-adapter-spec

fallback_rules: When evidence is missing, mark the statement [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] and route it to @webex/web-client rather than inferring intent.
When a test result is cited, report the executed test count rather than the exit code; both test routes in this package exit 0 without running anything.
When a behavior claim conflicts between README.md and src/index.js, the code wins and src/docs/README.md records the conflict.
When asked to repair the browser test route, treat it as a change to @webex/storage-adapter-spec and escalate; it is outside this package's boundary.
